analyzed_vuln.description: Heap out-of-bounds read in FIX dissector due to missing payload length validation before fixed-offset accesses. In ndpi_search_fix(), it unconditionally reads packet->payload[0..5] when packet->tcp is set, but does not verify packet->payload_packet_len >= 6. With short TCP payloads, reads past the end trigger ASan at fix.c:38.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Data flows from fuzz_process_packet -> ndpi_detection_process_packet -> check_ndpi_tcp_flow_func (only requires payload_packet_len != 0) -> ndpi_search_fix. A TCP packet with non-zero but <6-byte payload reaches ndpi_search_fix, which then performs payload[0..5] signature checks ("8=FIX." / "8=...9=") and overreads heap buffer. No additional protocol-state constraints are needed beyond invocation of FIX callback on such a short payload.
